, Reason for Mistake: The Planner introduced an unsupported claim that there might be another “Bubblegum Alley” in San Diego’s Gaslamp Quarter and instructed the WebSurfer to prioritize investigating it and even infer approximate coordinates. This speculation was not based on any sources returned so far and deviated from the task, which simply asks where Bubblegum Alley (the gum-wall-like site) in California is located. Reliable sources already clearly identified the correct location as San Luis Obispo, CA; introducing San Diego created unnecessary confusion and risked an incorrect or overcomplicated answer.
